description:
Create a complete PowerPoint presentation (.pptx): a whole multi-slide deck, native and editable, in one call. `slides` is a list of create_slide intents (same form menu + data shapes — see create_slide). Slides fill in parallel and merge into one themed PPTX with page numbers. Include furniture: a hero_statement cover, section_divider breaks, and a closing (hero_statement variant=contact_closing via blocks-free slots).

BLOCKED (not billed)? If an error has `can_autofix:true`, merge its `patch` into the args at `patch_target`. Unchanged retries repeat the block. New form: browse_catalog(type=schema) first.



Also: mode=assemble merges existing slide job_ids as-rendered (free; theme_id does NOT re-theme them — render with create_deck(slides=[…], theme_id=…) for a unified theme); mode=fork clones a deck (free).
Polling: deck_id == job_id — manage_account(action=job, job_id=<deck_id>).

allow_partial.description: IGNORED. A deck bills per rendered slide and always returns its pptx; slides that failed or rendered badly are free and named in repair_actions.

deck_id.description: Existing deck ID (for mode=fork, or mode=render to update)

direction.description: Deck-level writing direction, inherited by every slide (a slide-level direction wins) — set it once for an Arabic/Hebrew deck. Covers/dividers rendered on an UPLOADED brand template keep that template's own layout direction. See create_slide.direction.

dry_run.description: Deck-level free pre-flight (cost:0, NO render/PPTX): returns a per-slide validation manifest [{i, form, fidelity_forecast, status, errors}] so you can fix bad slides before spending. A deck is one artifact, so validation is all-or-nothing — put dry_run here, not on individual slides. Resend without dry_run to render.

force_render.description: IGNORED (deck-level). pptx_url is always returned when at least one slide rendered, so there is nothing to force. Still meaningful on create_slide.

imagery.description: Deck-level imagery mode, inherited by every slide (a slide-level imagery wins). See create_slide.imagery.

imagery_tag.description: Deck-level subject declaration, inherited by every slide (a slide-level imagery_tag wins). Declare it once for a whole deck. See create_slide.imagery_tag.

job_ids.description: Slide job IDs to merge (for mode=assemble)

language.description: ISO 639-1 (default en) for every slide: furniture labels and authored fills follow it.

logo_id.description: Optional brand logo (from upload_asset purpose=logo) applied as chrome to every content slide in the deck.

mode.description: Default render. assemble/fork are free deck plumbing.

slides.description: each item is a create_slide intent (same form menu, typed fields, and data shapes as create_slide).

strict_policy.description: Optional CI-style gate for automated report pipelines. dry_run returns policy_result; render returns rejected/cost:0 if the policy fails.

max_density.description: Reject slides whose quality.density is above this level.

min_font_pt.description: Reject slides whose reported minimum font size is below this point size.

reject_ai_completed.description: Reject slides whose content was fully AI-completed.

reject_draft_variants.description: Reject slides rendered by a draft-maturity variant (see each slide's variant_maturity warning).

reject_field_warnings.description: Reject slides carrying any field-binding warning (field_ignored, input_shape_hint, normalized, variant_fallback, form_rerouted).

reject_ignored_fields.description: Reject slides whose supplied fields were not rendered (fidelity=partial / field_ignored).

reject_mixed.description: Reject slides with mixed verbatim and AI-completed content.

reject_truncated.description: Reject slides with truncated supplied content.

styling.description: Deck-level topical-design switch, inherited by every slide (a slide-level styling wins). See create_slide.styling.

name: create_deck
title: Create Multi-Slide Deck
